reportQualification: Exact selected indexes and quantitative verification claims transcribed from the agent final response; narrative caveats summarized below. This file does not claim byte identity with the conversation message. The agent reported no tools after lease expiry.
caveats: Historical sampled occurrence only; no current occupancy, countywide range, reproduction, establishment or origin claim.
SAMPLED_FISH is sufficient-effort metadata; a partial survey does not negate positive captures. All selected FISH_SAMPLING flags are blank.
Nonwadeable section12.1 permits tissue collection when assemblage sampling is impossible, but does not prove the method of a flagged record. The three flagged alternatives remain unselected.
Source STATECTY and county names are publisher assignments. NAD83 coordinates are NHD sampling-frame points; border flags do not justify neighboring county assignments.
Northern-snakehead maps exactly to Channa argus. No hybrid, genus or ambiguous-rank collapse; subset voucher QA is not proof that every selected specimen was vouchered.
